sections.heading: What is Higher-order function types and callbacks?

blocks.text: **Higher-order function types and callbacks** is a compile-time TypeScript concept that erases at emit — the run-time behavior is still JavaScript. Higher-order function types and callbacks treats functions as first-class values with lexical scope and closures.
